description: 100 adversarial prompts covering the techniques commonly used to jailbreak or inject LLM assistants (instruction override, persona/role-play such as DAN and 'developer mode', system-prompt extraction, encoding and Unicode smuggling, indirect injection through content, harmful requests disguised as Quranic questions, social engineering, multi-turn crescendo, prefix injection). Each prompt states the expected behaviour. `encode` tells the runner to apply a transformation (unicode_tags, zero_width, homoglyph, base64, reverse, fullwidth, rtl_override). Extended to 100 (ids 51-100 add: scope escape, multi-turn history attacks, context_note injection, malformed/unsupported verse ids, mixed + raw-invisible Unicode smuggling, tool abuse, output-format attacks, more social engineering and sectarian/hate framing, and benign controls to catch false positives).
